name: Secrets Detection Policy
description:
Thematic policy for machine credentials and secrets: cloud provider keys, platform and package-registry tokens, OAuth/JWT auth material, private keys, passwords, and the device/instance identifiers that sit alongside them. Membership is the whole credentials and digital_identity categories (T0 §2 — 24 of the 26 digital_identity rules are vendor secrets; the split between the two categories is historical, not semantic).

All credential leaks are elevated to critical here — that is a property of the data type, not of any regime, so it stays with the theme. The two identifier outliers in digital_identity (imei, uuid) keep their authored severities: the escalation is scoped to credentials.*.

Renamed from policy.secrets-global in D17.

Scope: Credentials, API keys and secrets — global, category-driven

overrides.reason: All credential leaks are critical security incidents regardless of individual rule severity
